The '''Attack on Porus Vida''' was a one-sided bombing of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] world of [[Porus Vida]] by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ivan Cronus]] of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in the ''[[13X]]'' and his fleet of [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory''-class Star Destroyers]], taking place in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]]. Porus Vida was a civilan target known for its beauty and culture chosen as a psychological strike.
